description: A supplier has sent a formal quote as a PDF. File the PDF in both the supplier folder and the project folder, create the quote record, and update the supplier relationship file and the project file.

steps.description: Download the PDF attachment. Capture pdf_filename and pdf_size_bytes.
Save the PDF into the supplier's attachments folder and the project folder.
Create the quote record in PocketBase with the create_quote MCP tool.
Add the quote to the supplier's RELATIONSHIP.md (Active Quotes, Documents on File and Change Log), stating list price, discount, net price and tax basis.
Run the update-project-md playbook for this project with update_type='new_quote'.
